milestone.title: mp milestone per-stage mp-flow tracker + raul Stage column

intent.outcome: Every milestone carries a per-stage map of the 12 mp-flow stages. The raul Milestones list replaces the 8-cell lifecycle gauge with a single Stage column (`5/12 · Claim & execute`); the MilestoneDetail view gains a Stages checklist. Lifecycle writers auto-derive the canonical stage transitions; agents can override via `mp milestone stage set`. After this lands, a handoff agent can read `mp show milestone <id>` and know exactly which mp-flow stage the milestone is in.

problem.description: Today the 8-state lifecycle (`draft → groomed → approved → in-progress → done → ... → complete`) and the 12-stage mp-flow (`Draft → Groom → Specify → Approve → Claim & execute → Self-review → Complete → External review → Remediate → Re-review → Document → Hand off`) describe different things, but the TUI only surfaces the 8-state lifecycle. The 8-cell gauge in the Milestones list conflates the two and answers "what bucket is this in?" instead of the operator question "what step am I on?". The detail header line shows only the lifecycle badge, so when a handoff agent picks up after a session ends it has to re-derive the mp-flow position from prose in the milestone spec. M185 introduced the gauge as a stopgap; this milestone replaces it with the mp-flow truth and makes per-stage state explicit on disk so future automation (resume, audit, dashboards) can rely on it.

in_scope: Add `flow_stages: BTreeMap<String, FlowStage>` + `FlowStage { status, at }` to `MilestoneMeta` in `crates/mp-model/src/milestone.rs`. Status values: `pending`, `in_progress`, `done`, `skipped`. `#[serde(default)]` so legacy JSON without the field loads fine.

Auto-derive stage transitions from the `MilestoneEvent` table: `Groom` → `draft` done + `groom` done; `Approve` → `specify` done + `approve` done; `Start` → `execute` in_progress; `FinishExecution` → `execute` done + `self-review` done (bundled per M148); `Complete` → `complete` done AND `external-review` in_progress (the milestone is now in the review queue); `EnterRemediation` → `external-review` done + `remediate` in_progress; `ExitRemediation` → `remediate` done + `re-review` done; `Cancel` → all non-done stages set to `skipped`. `mp reviews pass --verdict ok` (not a MilestoneEvent) sets `external-review` done.

New CLI surface `mp milestone stage list|set <id> <stage> <status>` — list returns the 12-stage map; `set` overrides an explicit stage without breaking the auto-derive contract for other stages. Status enum guard rejects values outside `pending|done|in_progress|skipped`.

`mp milestone bulk set-stage --ids … --stage … --status …` mirrors `bulk set-priority` / `bulk set-spec-status` (uses `--dry-run`, `--where`, reports succeeded/failed with exit code 2 on partial failure).

Late-stage auto-advance: `mp note add --milestone-id <id>` and `mp reviews finding resolve <id>` flip `flow_stages.document.status = "done"` for the associated milestone when its current lifecycle is `complete`. `flow_stages.hand-off` only flips via explicit `mp milestone stage set <id> hand-off done`.
Project `flow_stages` in `mp show milestone <id>` JSON and in the `mp list milestones` payload so downstream consumers (raul, future dashboards) don't need a second `mp` call per row.

TUI Milestones list: replace the 8-cell Gauge column with a Stage column rendering `<N>/12 · <Stage Label>` from `MilestoneSummary.flow_stages`. The lifecycle text column is removed (the Stage cell already carries position). Since + indent + priority columns unchanged.

TUI MilestoneDetail: insert a `Stages` section between Meta and G14. All 12 stages render as `✓/●/○/⊘ <label> [<timestamp or relative>]` in canonical mp-flow order. The current-stage row gets an indented sub-line `└─ lifecycle overlay: <cancelled|blocked|remediation>` only when the milestone's lifecycle overlay is non-empty. Detail header line replaces the lifecycle badge with the Stage cell (e.g. `5/12 · Claim & execute`).

TUI Dashboard lifecycle grid: replace the 9-bucket lifecycle rollup with a 12-bucket mp-flow rollup. Each bucket label includes its `N/12` ordinal marker. Pre-existing complete milestones roll up under `Complete` until their next transition — no code-side backfill per the migration decision.
Extend `MilestoneSummary` (in `crates/raul/src/tui/app.rs`) to carry `flow_stages` so list rendering doesn't need a second mp call per row.

Tests: unit (derivation table, status enum guard, CLI overrides, late-stage hooks, reviews-pass hook); TUI snapshot/golden for Stage column and Stages section; round-trip serde tests for the new field. `make test` and `make lint` clean.
out_of_scope: Slice A (description field on milestones/backlog/ideas) — separate milestone later; this one stays focused on stage tracking.

Code-side backfill or migration of pre-existing milestone JSON files — `#[serde(default)]` only. Pre-existing milestones render an empty Stages section (all `○` with `(unknown)` timestamp) until their first lifecycle transition populates the field. The user manually pre-populates if needed.

Removing the underlying 8-state lifecycle from `MilestoneMeta` — lifecycle continues to drive overlay state, the path engine, and existing mp-status reports. The Milestones list Lifecycle text column and Gauge are removed in this milestone (replaced by the Stage cell). The Stage cell is additive to the data model, not to the list layout.
Backlog/Ideas list columns stay unchanged (no Stage column there — backlog items are not mp-flow participants).
Replacing the 12-stage ordering on disk — the canonical order lives in `templates/skills/mp-flow/stages.toml`; this milestone reads from the same source but does not modify the SKILL.md.
Review-loop counter (how many times stages 8→9→10 have iterated) — only the final state is recorded (`remediate: done`, `re-review: done`); iteration count is out of scope.
TUI Path tab visual enrichment — unchanged here; M206 owns the Path 2-line rework and depends on this milestone's flow_stages field.
Watch tab, Settings tab, Overview Health strip — unchanged.
Bulk-set helpers beyond `bulk set-stage` — operators needing bulk lifecycle changes already use `bulk set-spec-status`; stage-level bulk is the only new bulk surface.
Per-stage `blocked` status — the four-value enum (`pending/done/in_progress/skipped`) is enough for v1; if a future milestone needs stage-level blocking, add a fifth value then.

design_decisions.choice: Auto-derive from lifecycle transitions + CLI override
design_decisions.rationale: Lifecycle transitions are the canonical events that produce stage progress. Wiring the auto-derive into the existing `MilestoneEvent` table keeps the state machine single-source. CLI override exists for stages the lifecycle can't observe (Self-review bundling, Document, Hand-off) and for explicit operator intent.

design_decisions.choice: Replace the gauge column with the Stage column
design_decisions.rationale: The gauge was an mp-flow-shaped visualization of an 8-state value — exactly the conflation the milestone is fixing. Replacing it removes the redundancy and makes the Stage column the single visual signal.

design_decisions.choice: BTreeMap<String, FlowStage> with FlowStage { status, at }
design_decisions.rationale: Forward-compatible — adding a future stage is a serde-side change, not a model migration. Per-stage timestamps enable the relative-time display in the Stages section. Serde-default on the field keeps legacy JSON loadable.

Four values cover every reachable state. `skipped` is distinct from `pending` so cancelled milestones render visually different from "not yet started". A fifth `blocked` value can be added later if stage-level blocking becomes a requirement.
Both the ordinal and the label matter — the label names the work, the ordinal anchors position. Single cell, no need to scroll the lifecycle column for context.

M148 Option A removed the separate `self-reviewed` lifecycle state and folded self-review into the runner's pre-complete flow. The Stage cell mirrors that — `execute` and `self-review` flip `done` together at `FinishExecution`. No new event needed.

`document` naturally follows the first post-complete note or finding resolution — auto-detect removes ceremony for the common path. `hand-off` is the ceremonial close-out; explicit signal prevents a stray commit from prematurely closing the milestone.

The repo is dogfood-only and the user is the sole operator. Manually pre-populating (or letting the field fill on first transition) is acceptable. No `mp migrate` command needed; the dashboard rollup will show pre-existing complete milestones under `Complete` instead of `Hand off` until they get touched — acceptable per user confirmation.
The Stage cell already conveys position. Two cells saying the same thing reduces horizontal budget for future columns (description, in slice A) without adding information.

design_decisions.choice: Stage cell replaces the lifecycle badge; overlay sub-line under the current stage row
design_decisions.rationale: Lean header for the 95% normal case; terminal-state signal (`cancelled` / `blocked` / `remediation`) lives as a sub-line under the current stage row in the Stages section. Avoids redundancy while preserving the signal where it matters.

design_decisions.choice: Complete sets external-review to in_progress. reviews pass sets it done. EnterRemediation also sets it done (findings were filed). Do not leave stages 8-12 pending after complete — the Stage column current-stage helper treats first non-done as current, but the detail checklist would show a hollow pending for the stage the operator is actually on.
design_decisions.rationale: The original auto-derive table had no event for stage 8. After complete the operator is in the review queue; pretending otherwise makes the 12-stage tracker lie. There is no mp reviews claim command in the current CLI (AGENTS.md is stale), so complete and reviews pass are the observable edges.

open_questions.question: How does `mp note add` (or `mp reviews finding resolve`) associate with a milestone for the late-stage `document` auto-advance? Today `mp note add` has no required `milestone_id`; should the milestone CLI add one, or should the hook use a heuristic (most-recent `complete` milestone touched in the last N hours)?
open_questions.answer: Add optional --milestone-id <id> flag to  (backwards-compatible; default empty). The late-stage  auto-advance hook reads --milestone-id when present; falls back to the existing heuristic-free behavior (no auto-advance) when absent. Updates AC-10 verification commands to cover the explicit-id path.

open_questions.question: Does `mp milestone stage set` accept a stage key not in the canonical 12 (forward-compat), or reject with a precise error?
open_questions.answer: Strict guard. mp milestone stage set rejects any stage key not in the canonical 12 (draft, groom, specify, approve, execute, self-review, complete, external-review, remediate, re-review, document, hand-off) with a precise error listing the allowed keys. Exit code 2. No on-disk mutation. Mirrors the existing set_lifecycle enum guard.

open_questions.question: Should the bulk `set-stage` command auto-skip cancelled milestones (write to them is a no-op), or attempt the write and let the lifecycle guard reject it?
open_questions.answer: auto-skips cancelled milestones — the write is a no-op for those targets. The bulk summary lists each skipped target with reason  in the per-id report. Exit code 0 if all non-cancelled targets succeeded; 2 on partial failure.

findings.description: AC-16 broken end-to-end: the raul dashboard 12-bucket grid always shows zero counts. raul reads snap.mp_flow_stage_counts from the overview snapshot (crates/raul/src/tui/render/dashboard_view.rs:265) but NOTHING on the mp side emits that field — grep 'mp_flow_stage_counts' crates/mp/src/ is empty, and 'target/debug/mp overview' top-level keys are only activity/health/inbox/lifecycle/path/queues/steps/totals. crates/raul/src/overview_snapshot.rs:66 declares the field with the comment 'added by the mp side per M202' but no mp-side change exists in the M202 diff. The 4 AC-16 tests only assert bucket labels/order/title, never counts from a real payload, so the verification regex passes while the rollup is dead.

AC-01 drift: AC says show milestone JSON includes flow_stages 'keyed by all 12 mp-flow stage slugs', but the implementation stores only fired stages (M202 itself shows just execute+self-review; untouched stages are absent). The test crates/mp/tests/lifecycle_setter_overlay.rs:1091 re-interprets the AC in a comment ('untouched stages may be absent') without the AC wording being amended and without a declared-drift finding. Either expand show output to all 12 keys or amend AC-01.

ExitRemediation drift: S3 action and scope.in_scope say 'ExitRemediation → remediate done + re-review done', but crates/mp-model/src/milestone.rs:1484 sets re-review to in_progress (unit test at :2634 asserts in_progress). The code comment rationalizes the change ('back in the review queue waiting on the re-review pass') but the approved spec was not updated and no drift finding was declared.

AC-09 vs implementation: Cancel excludes hand-off from the skipped flip (crates/mp-model/src/milestone.rs Cancel arm skips 'hand-off'), so a cancelled milestone leaves hand-off pending/absent while AC-09 says 'flips every non-done stage to skipped' and scope says 'all non-done stages set to skipped'. The code comment justifies via AC-11, but skipping is not auto-advancing to done — the exclusion is undeclared drift and feeds the raul 12/12 render bug.

raul Stage cell renders '12/12 · Hand-off' for real cancelled milestones. After cancel, all remaining stages are skipped and hand-off is absent; crates/raul/src/tui/progress.rs current_mp_flow_stage's second pass treats absent hand-off as pending and ignores skipped stages, so a milestone cancelled at stage 4 displays 12/12 · Hand-off in the list column and detail header. The cancelled case in tui_lifecycle_gauge_render.rs:120 uses a synthetic fixture (skipped entries omitted → 6/12) that masks real cancel output; no test covers realistic cancel state. Also diverges from S15's stated fallback ('last done stage plus its label').

Per-AC evidence is one generic string on all 19 ACs plus verification.evidence: 'All 22 steps + 19 ACs done. Full matrix green: make test (3268 tests), clippy mp+raul+mp-model -D warnings, mp validate exit 0.' — the exact M200 F-12 pattern the series already flagged (lesson 5). Lifecycle gate requires non-prose per-AC evidence (command + exit code + test count per AC). Also internally inconsistent: commit 9580636 says 3267 tests, evidence says 3268 (actual make test: 3268 passed + 1 skipped).

AC-17 verification is 'make test' which runs cargo nextest run + cargo fmt --check only — it does not run cargo clippy -p mp/raul or mp validate, all of which AC-17's description asserts exit 0. The verification command must exercise every assertion in the AC description (clippy + mp validate are currently ungated by the per-AC gate; they could regress silently).

AC-15/S18 sub-line placement drift: crates/raul/src/tui/render/milestone_detail.rs pushes the '└─ lifecycle overlay: <state>' sub-line AFTER all 12 stage rows, but AC-15 says 'the current-stage row carries the sub-line' and S18 says 'Under the current-stage row'. For a milestone at stage 5 the sub-line renders after the hand-off row. The 4 AC-15 tests pin only presence, not placement. Secondary edge: for legacy milestones with no flow_stages key, current_stage_slug is None and the sub-line is silently suppressed even when the overlay is set.

Undeclared out-of-scope changes bundled into M202 commits: crates/raul/src/tui/render/tab_bar.rs lane-index fix (labeled 'M198 follow-up') and the M201 settings-schema fetch refactor (crates/raul/src/tui/modes/settings/schema.rs + runner_helpers.rs) both landed in commit 9580636 without any M202 step covering them and without a declared-drift finding. Neither relates to flow_stages/Stage column.

S13 done_when claims 'manual: mp list milestones --fields flow_stages returns the map per row' — that command errors ('unknown path: flow_stages'; --fields on mp list rejects top-level keys, confirmed with target/debug/mp). The actual pinned surface is the default JSON row field plus --select flow_stages (list_projection_flags.rs:418). Step done_when wording should match the real command.

Canonical 12-stage table is hard-coded in THREE places: crates/mp-model/src/milestone.rs MP_FLOW_STAGE_KEYS + mp_flow_stage_label, and a duplicated copy in crates/raul/src/tui/progress.rs (comment says 'keep in sync'). No code reads templates/skills/mp-flow/stages.toml, contradicting scope.out_of_scope which claims 'this milestone reads from the same source'. make mp-flow-lint guards SKILL.md vs stages.toml but nothing guards code vs stages.toml — the copies can silently diverge.

F-01 rollup mis-buckets all legacy milestones as draft: mp_model::current_mp_flow_stage treats absent flow_stages entries as pending, so every pre-M202 milestone (empty map) derives 'draft'. Live check: mp overview shows mp_flow_stage_counts = {draft: 202, all-others: 0} while the legacy lifecycle rollup says 195 complete + 4 approved. The Migration design decision documents 'pre-existing complete milestones roll up under Complete until their next transition' — the F-01 writer contradicts it, so the dashboard grid and the raul Stage column show '1/12 Define outcome' for 195 complete milestones. The F-01 test (crates/mp/tests/milestone_log.rs) only drives a fresh milestone through the pipeline; no test covers the legacy/empty-map fallback.

F-06 fix overwritten by the completion step: commit 256b926 restored per-AC evidence (command + exit + test count), but the cycle-2 completion commit 10a5586 replaced ALL 19 acceptance_criteria[].evidence fields AND verification.evidence with the placeholder string 'M202 cycle 2 retry'. Current state: every AC carries the same prose placeholder, not test output — the M200 F-12 pattern repeating a third time. Restore per-AC evidence AFTER the final mp milestone complete (stamp each AC with its verification command + exit code + test count).
